meta.name: sqs
meta.description: AWS SQS message queue service for decoupled architectures. Use when creating queues, configuring dead-letter queues, managing visibility timeouts, implementing FIFO ordering, or integrating with Lambda.

copy.tagline: 管理 AWS SQS 队列与消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 AWS 上创建和管理消息队列
copy.tagline_en: Manage AWS SQS queues and messages
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create and manage message queues on AWS

howto.what: Claude 可以帮你创建和管理 AWS SQS 队列，包括标准队列和 FIFO 队列，配置死信队列、可见性超时、消息发送与接收，以及集成 Lambda 函数。
howto.when: 当你需要处理 AWS SQS 消息队列，例如创建队列、配置死信队列、管理可见性超时、实现 FIFO 排序或与 Lambda 集成时。

say.text: 帮我创建一个标准队列，可见性超时设为60秒。
配置一个死信队列，最大接收次数为3。
say.note: Claude 会提供设置死信队列的步骤和命令。

say.text: 发送一条包含订单ID的消息到队列。
say.note: Claude 会给出发送消息的代码示例。

howto.what_en: Claude can help you create and manage AWS SQS queues, including standard and FIFO queues, configure dead-letter queues, visibility timeouts, send and receive messages, and integrate with Lambda.
howto.when_en: When you need to work with AWS SQS message queues, such as creating queues, configuring dead-letter queues, managing visibility timeouts, implementing FIFO ordering, or integrating with Lambda.

say_en.text: Create a standard queue with visibility timeout of 60 seconds.
say_en.note: Claude will generate CLI or boto3 code to create the queue.

say_en.text: Configure a dead-letter queue with max receive count of 3.
say_en.note: Claude will provide steps and commands to set up the DLQ.

say_en.text: Send a message with an order ID to the queue.
say_en.note: Claude will give a code example for sending a message.
